about: Where the TabeebX logo is printed on knock.jpg (assets/shots/, AI-generated, kept out of git) by scripts/embed-logo.mjs. quad: the four corners in photo pixels, TL TR BR BL. lit: the brightness of the cloth (0-1) where the print is fully exposed; floor: how dark the print gets in shade; fold: how strongly the cloth's folds shape the print; ink: how uneven the ink is; micro: how much of the cloth's own grain shows through the print.
